seo.title: Engineering in Australia for Indian Students | Edu-Hawk Worldwide
seo.description: Study Bachelor's in Engineering in Australia for Indian students. Learn about Bachelor of Engineering (Honours), top universities (UNSW, Melbourne, Sydney, Monash), eligibility, fees, Engineers Australia accreditation, and career opportunities.

hero.title: For Indian Students, Study Engineering in Australia
hero.subtitle: Engineering programs in civil, mechanical, electrical, software, chemical, aerospace, and emerging technology domains are available in Australia. Undergraduate, graduate, diploma, certificate, and research options are available to Indian students.

overview: Australian universities deliver globally recognized engineering education accredited by Engineers Australia under the Washington Accord. Students benefit from modern research facilities, practical design projects, industry internships, and international career opportunities.

faq.question: After Class 12, are Indian students able to pursue engineering studies in Australia?
faq.answer: Yes, if they fulfill the academic, subject, and English language requirements of the university.

faq.question: What is the duration of an Australian engineering degree?
faq.answer: While master's programs typically take one to two years, many bachelor's degrees require three to four years.

faq.question: Is it necessary to learn mathematics?
faq.answer: Mathematics is a prerequisite for many engineering programs, and some also call for physics or other science courses.

faq.question: Is taking the IELTS required?
faq.answer: The university's English language requirements must be met by students, while there are several exceptions and acceptable tests.

faq.question: What is the approximate cost of tuition?
faq.answer: Depending on the course and school, many programs cost between AUD 35,000 and AUD 70,000 or more annually.
